definitions.short: perhaps to swell up , i.e. blister
definitions.full: H1216. batseq בָּצֵק verb swell — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular בָּעֵ֑קָה Deut 8:4 ; 3 plural בָּצֵ֑קוּ Neh 9:21 ; — swell , or receive swellings, blisters , of foot, Di Deut 8:4 , Ry Neh 9:21 .

occurrences.englishText: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
“Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.
